# WordRoom

Private, client-side text and writing utilities. No upload, no account.

- [Word counter](https://wordroomonline.com/word-counter): Free online word counter and character counter. Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs as you type. Perfect for essays, articles and student assignments. Handles Telugu, Hindi and CJK correctly, and can exclude citations and reference lists for academic word limits.
- [Case converter](https://wordroomonline.com/case-converter): Convert text between title case, sentence case, UPPERCASE, camelCase, snake_case and more. Title case follows real AP and Chicago rules instead of capitalising every word.
- [Readability checker](https://wordroomonline.com/readability-checker): Score your writing with Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid, Gunning Fog, SMOG, Coleman-Liau and ARI. Shows which sentences are dragging the score down.
- [Remove line breaks](https://wordroomonline.com/remove-line-breaks): Strip unwanted line breaks from text copied out of PDFs and emails while keeping real paragraph breaks intact. Also trims lines and collapses double spaces.
- [Sort lines](https://wordroomonline.com/sort-lines): Sort any list of lines alphabetically, by length, in reverse or shuffled. Supports natural number ordering and locale-aware alphabetising for non-English lists.
- [Remove duplicate lines](https://wordroomonline.com/remove-duplicate-lines): Find and remove duplicate lines from any list. Choose whether case and surrounding whitespace count, and inspect which values repeat before you delete anything.
- [Base64 encoder / decoder](https://wordroomonline.com/base64-encoder-decoder): Encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 back to text directly in your browser. Unicode-safe, private and free with no upload or account.
- [URL encoder / decoder](https://wordroomonline.com/url-encoder-decoder): Encode or decode URL text and query-string components online. Choose URI or component mode and process everything locally in your browser.
- [Regex tester](https://wordroomonline.com/regex-tester): Test JavaScript regular expressions against your text in real time. See matches, capture groups, match counts and regex errors directly in your browser.
- [Password generator](https://wordroomonline.com/password-generator): Generate strong random passwords using your browser's cryptographic random generator. Choose length and character sets. Nothing is uploaded.
- [JSON formatter](https://wordroomonline.com/json-formatter): Format and pretty-print JSON with adjustable indentation. Invalid JSON is explained with an error instead of silently changing your data.
- [JSON validator](https://wordroomonline.com/json-validator): Validate JSON syntax instantly in your browser and get a useful error message when the input is invalid. No upload or account required.
- [JSON minifier](https://wordroomonline.com/json-minifier): Minify valid JSON by removing unnecessary whitespace while preserving its data. Runs entirely in your browser.
- [JWT decoder](https://wordroomonline.com/jwt-decoder): Decode the header and payload of a JSON Web Token locally in your browser. The tool does not verify signatures and does not send your token to a server.
- [UUID generator](https://wordroomonline.com/uuid-generator): Generate random UUID version 4 identifiers using your browser's cryptographic random source. Create one or multiple UUIDs instantly.
- [Hash generator](https://wordroomonline.com/hash-generator): Generate SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 or SHA-512 hashes from text using the browser Web Crypto API. Your input never leaves the browser.
- [Slug generator](https://wordroomonline.com/slug-generator): Convert titles and text into clean, URL-friendly slugs. Lowercase text, remove unnecessary punctuation and replace spaces with hyphens.
